_note: One bounded UrbanFlow SQL alert validation on an explicitly approved shared serverless SQL warehouse. Read-only query, one alert created, evaluated, then deleted. No data was read or written outside a single SELECT, and no other workspace object was touched.

warehouse.name: Serverless Starter Warehouse
warehouse.stop_mechanism: auto-stop after 5 idle minutes; CAN_USE does not permit a manual stop and none was attempted
warehouse.billing_note: serverless SQL on the shared academy account, not a personal account

query.text: SELECT SUM(CASE WHEN availability_status IN ('LOW_BIKES','LOW_DOCKS','LOW_BIKES_AND_DOCKS') THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS actionable_shortages FROM dbr_dev.parvinbadalov_urbanflow.silver_station_status
query.derived_from: sql/10_dashboard_current_operations.sql query 1, reduced to the single alerting measure

alert.owner: the workspace identity already recorded as `workspace_user` in databricks.yml

condition.threshold_rationale: A defect-free threshold rather than a tuned one: zero actionable shortages genuinely means there is nothing for an operator to do, so `> 0` is the correct boundary and was not chosen to force a result.

evaluation.how: The schedule was created PAUSED. To obtain a real evaluation rather than asserting the arithmetic by hand, it was briefly UNPAUSED with a one-minute cron, allowed to evaluate exactly once, then re-PAUSED immediately.

notification.destination_type: email subscription to the alert owner's own workspace identity
notification.delivery_note: The alert transitioned to TRIGGERED with one email subscription configured and `notify_on_ok` false, which is the condition under which Databricks sends the notification. The recipient mailbox was NOT inspected, so delivery is inferred from the triggered transition rather than independently confirmed.

schedule.temporarily: UNPAUSED with cron 0 * * * * ? for one evaluation
schedule.why_paused: The underlying table is one frozen GBFS snapshot, so a live cron would fire identically forever and spend warehouse time while nobody is watching. A standing schedule becomes meaningful only once the data refreshes.

alert.cleanup_rationale: Deleted after validation so no scheduled alert is left behind in a shared academy workspace, which already holds 25 alerts belonging to other labs and students.
